# Debian/Raspberry Pi OS packages the speaker needs on top of a stock
# Raspberry Pi OS (64-bit, trixie). Installed by ./install.sh bootstrap-system.

# audio stack (most are already on the desktop image)
pipewire
pipewire-pulse
pipewire-bin
wireplumber
alsa-utils
libasound2-plugins
ffmpeg            # decodes the chimes and alarm sounds (sound_fx.py)
playerctl         # MPRIS control of spotifyd (buttons, voice tools)
avahi-utils       # Spotify Connect discovery checks

# hardware
dfu-util          # XVF3800 firmware flashing
python3-gpiozero  # volume-buttons.py (system Python)
python3-lgpio
iw
network-manager

# system-Python services
python3-venv
python3-psutil    # thermal-monitor
python3-dbus

# tools
curl
ca-certificates
unzip
git

# building spotifyd (rustup provides the toolchain itself)
libssl-dev
libpulse-dev
libdbus-1-dev
libasound2-dev
pkg-config
